title: Namespace
description: Namespace YAML schema v1 for s3.chedaws.io/v1 Namespace. metadata.name is the identity field that determines the IAM role name and S3 namespace prefix. spec.producer declares the producer's identity per environment; an IAM role edp-<env>-s3-producer-<name> is provisioned with s3:PutObject scoped to <name>/* in the landing bucket.

name.description: Namespace identifier (e.g. finance, risk, platform). Lowercase, hyphens allowed. Must match the YAML file stem. Used as the IAM role name segment and S3 prefix. Hyphens are normalised to underscores in the Glue database name only.

owner.description: Team slug responsible for this namespace

environments.description: Environments where this namespace producer is active. At least one environment must be declared.

^(dev|test|uat|prod)$.description: IAM identity for this namespace producer in the named environment. Exactly one of iamRoles or certificateSubject must be present.

iamRoles.description: IAM role ARNs in the producer's AWS account that will assume the EDP namespace producer role

certificateSubject.description: Certificate CN values for IAM Roles Anywhere trust (on-premises producers).
